name: Ayumi-Chan Diary -Shiro-
original_name: あゆみちゃんだいありぃ-白-
source:
CottonClub's “Ayumi-chan Diary -Shiro-” is an omnibus adventure game where you get to cuddle with a little girl. It's a secret diary in which the quiet, shy little girl “Ayumi-chan” chronicles her summer vacation memories with a sexy older guy!


[From [url=https://www.ura-akiba.jp/archives/2017/04/50cottonclub.html]ura-akiba.jp[/url]]
